meta.title: Genesis Technology — Professional Beverage Systems
meta.description: We design, build, and service professional beverage systems for hotels, offices, and restaurant chains. One team, one roof — complete accountability.

items.title:
Your beverage operation
should *run itself.*
items.subtitle: We design, build, and service every machine ourselves. So when you need us, we're already there.

items.title:
Every component.
Every line of code.
*Ours.*

One call.
*One team.*
One fix.
items.content: We design, build, and service every machine from our facility in Plovdiv. Hardware, software, cloud platform — all under one roof. When your machine needs a recipe update, a replacement part, or a software fix, one phone call handles everything.

items.title: Built, not bought
items.content: We design and build every system in our own facility in Plovdiv — hardware, software, everything. Full control means faster fixes, better quality, and machines made exactly for the job.

items.title: Uptime across all sites
items.content: Your machine works when you need it. We monitor proactively and resolve issues before they reach your guests.

items.title: Service response
items.content: Our engineers are in Plovdiv. Spare parts are manufactured in-house. When you call, someone who knows your machine picks up.

items.title: Consistent quality, every cup
items.content: From the first cup of the morning to the last one at midnight, every drink meets the same standard. Our system adjusts recipes automatically to keep quality locked in.

items.title: Cloud intelligence, built in
items.content: The cloud platform is the core of every machine. Track consumption in real time, change recipes remotely, and get alerts before issues need attention.

items.title: Designed for your team
items.content: Intuitive touchscreens, self-cleaning cycles, and clear alerts. Your staff operates with confidence from day one. Less training, smoother shifts.

items.title: Genesis Universa
items.content: Our flagship. Biodegradable E.S.E pods and fresh-ground coffee from the same machine. Set up the menu you want — the machine adapts to you.
items.label: Quick Service · Cafeterias · Hotels · Retail

items.title: Genesis Alpha
items.content: Dual bean hoppers, automatic milk, built-in AI cloud. Hundreds of cups a day, self-cleaning, zero compromises.
items.label: Hotels · Restaurants · Offices

items.title: Genesis Prime
items.content: Full cloud functionality in a compact footprint. Intelligent management and mobile access — perfect for offices and boutique venues.
items.label: Offices · Boutique Hotels · Retail

items.title: Coffee systems
items.content: Every machine shares the same cloud platform, the same service network, and the same commitment to quality.

items.title: Genesis Eclipse
items.content: Over 250 cocktail recipes, automated portioning, built-in CO₂. Up to 40% savings on beverage costs.
items.label: Cocktail Bar System

items.title: Genesis Solaris 2
items.content: Fresh juices, wellness blends, flavoured water. Large touchscreen, fully customisable menus.
items.label: Fusion & Wellness

items.title: Genesis Equinox
items.content: Frappés, cold chocolate, fresh lemonades. Compact, fits behind any counter. New recipes via cloud.
items.label: Frappés & Lemonades

items.title: Bar & cold systems
items.content: Cocktails, juices, frappés, lemonades — every cold drink your operation needs, from one partner.

items.title: See what's happening, everywhere
items.content: Real-time consumption data across every machine and every location. Know which drinks are popular, when demand peaks, and where attention is needed.

items.title: Change recipes from your phone
items.content: Update drink menus, adjust strength and portions, roll out seasonal specials — all remotely. Changes reach every machine in your fleet instantly.

items.title: Alerts before you notice a problem
items.content: The platform monitors machine health continuously. When something needs attention, you know first — before it affects a single guest.

items.quote: Genesis machines have been running flawlessly for 5 years. The cloud system gives us full control over consumption and helps us plan more efficiently.
items.author: Hotel Maritsa

image.alt: Genesis machine at Business Park Plovdiv

items.quote: We switched to Genesis and the difference was immediate — better coffee, real cost visibility, and a team that actually picks up the phone.
items.author: Business Park Plovdiv

items.quote: The cloud system saves us hours every week. Recipes, statistics, maintenance alerts — everything is managed from the phone.
items.author: Restaurant Vereya

items.title: We listen
items.content: Tell us about your operation — volume, space, drink preferences, guest profile. We'll recommend the system that fits, not the one that's easiest to sell.

items.title: We set up
items.content: Our team installs, calibrates, and configures everything on-site. Your staff gets hands-on training so they're confident from day one.

items.title: We stay
items.content: Cloud monitoring, remote diagnostics, local engineers on call. We don't disappear after installation — we're your long-term partner.

items.title:
Let's find the right setup
for *your* operation.
items.subtitle: We'll review your needs, recommend a configuration, and give you a clear proposal. Most consultations take 30 minutes. No pressure, no generic pitch.
